title: Fine Print
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Fine Print and the helm marks Expired Charter. Do: Close on Expired Charter. The law here is red. An ambush holds the school buoy, a kite keeps 340 to 460 meters, and a raider takes the Expired Clerk, who runs inside 640 meters. Finish: come inside Expired Charter's shell. The Charter writes standing. Wreck rights stay red. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
